description: Header file defining the UidObserver class, which implements a callback mechanism to monitor UID and process termination events in Android's media resource management system.

classes.name: UidObserver
classes.description: Implements callback mechanisms for UID and process lifecycle events, including registration with ActivityManager and handling process termination notifications.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Registers the observer with the Application Manager to start receiving UID events.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Unregisters the observer from the Application Manager.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a pid/uid pair to the set of observed processes.

methods.name: onUidGone
methods.description: Callback invoked when a UID is no longer active.

methods.name: onUidActive
methods.description: Callback invoked when a UID becomes active.

methods.name: onUidIdle
methods.description: Callback invoked when a UID becomes idle.

methods.name: onUidStateChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when the state of a UID changes.

methods.name: onUidProcAdjChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when the process adjustment for a UID changes.

methods.name: onServiceRegistration
methods.description: Handles registration of services with the Activity Manager.

methods.name: binderDied
methods.description: Handles the death of a binder object.

methods.name: registerWithActivityManager
methods.description: Registers the observer with the Activity Manager for UID events.

methods.name: getTerminatedProcesses
methods.description: Checks whether specified processes are terminated.
